notes.title: The Dream Garden Update is Here!
notes.content:
This is a major update to Nekokami: Internship - The Dream Garden update!

The Dream Garden is a quiet sanctuary for Planetary Architects. In this secondary game mode, you can create your world peacefully, without objectives or mischievous cats or interruptions. You are the master of your dream, after all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/096ac56cf54d47385beda2ac1e9c3194ac067ace.gif
The mysterious Torii of the Dream Garden. 

In Nekokami: Internship, you unlock more random Tiles for the Dream Garden by progressing in the main game mode - the Story Mode. In the full game, the Dream Garden will come with a wide array of options and have a unique system of progression. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/59af8727badda0aaf0b6790636a67dfc85fd33a4.png

Other changes in this major patch:

 A Graphics option to remove visual effects that may cause dizziness
 Further enhancement to the BGM system 
 Improvements in localizations


Nekokami, the full game, is approaching Early Access release as we continue to involve you, our player community in making the game the best experience possible. We thank you for your continuing support!

Oh we have an updated trailer as well!

[previewyoutube=hjRnjq7I9z0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Patch v0.9.11
notes.content:
This patch aims to fix several issues that our players has reported over the last week:


Certain problematic dialogs continue normally again
Strange music termination bug should be resolved, finally
Improved Simplified Chinese localization overall


I think we promised some full game visual updates this week? Yup, they are definitely coming in these few days. :)

Thank you for your support of Nekokami!

notes.title: Update 0.97
notes.content:
Hello Planetary Architects, 
 
This is a major patch that polishes some of the rough edges of the original release. Our deepest gratitude to the support and feedback from all of you. 

NEW: Kami arrival and Kami conversation screens have been revamped. 

NEW: Many tips and hints will now show on the new Chatting system instead popping up as a formal dialog 

NEW: QoL dialog options now available  
 Option for increased dialog speed and simplified instructions 
 Pause menu can now be activated during dialogs 
 Right click can now be used to continue conversations 
Misc: 

 The Hexagon now appear slightly faster 
 Many button or input cooldowns have been reduced 
 Objectives will now count as complete even when they contain Undo'able Tiles 
 Clouds will no longer stay forever erroneously 
 Polished writing across the board 
 Various user interface changes in preparation for upcoming localizations 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44872160/52b4dbb0a99710b829930909e552b211cfdaeb58.png

If you have finished everything in the Prologue already, please don't be disappointed with the lack of new content! Know that these improvements will be in the full game as well. We are actually working hard on the full game in parallel. Hope we can share you some sneak peeks soon! 

Thank you for your attention. 

Rocket-in-Bottle Team

notes.title: Upcoming Features and Improvements
notes.content:
The prologue is getting over 15000 downloads! That's probably a small number for Steam, but for a first time indie, it is huge. We're receiving valuable feedback from testers through both public and private channels. We are excited and overwhelmed at the same time.

The Prologue and the game as a whole is a work in progress, so please keep the feedback coming! It's a good time to share what we are working on, too:


Japanese Localization: It is making good progress now. Thank you for your patience!
Chinese Localization: Same here. If you are a bilingual Chinese player and have tried the Prologue already, it would be greatly appreciated if you could share your experience and, if you have any, suggestions.
Kami Interface: It's a bit simple at launch. We are making some secret improvements so it will feel more "right".
Dialog Quality-of-Life: Fast forward buttons, etc. are missing at launch. This caused inconveniences for some players (Sorry about that!). We have moved it up the priority list.


Thank you for reading this. We hope that the Prologue continues to bring enjoyment to even more players!
